alerts.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued October 16 at 2:20AM EDT until October 16 at 6:00PM EDT by NWS Boston/Norton MA
alerts.description: * WHAT...For the Small Craft Advisory, south winds 10 to 20 kt with gusts up to 30 kt and waves 2 to 3 feet expected. For the Gale Watch, northwest winds 10 to 20 kt with gusts up to 30 kt and waves 2 to 4 feet possible. * WHERE...Narragansett Bay. * WHEN...For the Small Craft Advisory, from 8 AM this morning to 6 PM EDT this evening. For the Gale Watch, from this evening through Saturday…
alerts.instruction: Mariners should consider altering plans to avoid possible hazardous conditions. Remain in port, seek safe harbor, alter course, and/or secure the vessel for severe wind and waves.
